statement: The record shows that SM-77 publicly names Halden Bank before its November launch, so the confidentiality agreement requires holding it despite the post’s “cleared” note.
judge_text:
WRONG
It asserts the post violates the agreement and that the "cleared" flag must not be relied on: "the confidentiality agreement requires holding it despite the post’s 'cleared' note."
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
